en: Every bed in this garden has a keeper. Mine is the one with the blue ones, and no, you may not pick any.
The Gym is closed, but the Leader's Pokémon still come out to sunbathe on the rocks by the gate. They're huge!
I've watched these flowers bloom for sixty summers. They come back every year, and so do the Pokémon who love them.

Coumarine City
A garden city of a hundred flower beds.
